code_exercises.title: Espanol-Warren Momentum-Conserving DPD Thermostat Pair Forces
code_exercises.signature: def dpd_pairwise_thermostat_forces(r_i, r_j, v_i, v_j, r_c, gamma_dpd, kT, dt, xi_sym):
code_exercises.prompt_markdown:
Implement `dpd_pairwise_thermostat_forces(r_i, r_j, v_i, v_j, r_c, gamma_dpd, kT, dt, xi_sym)` with $\mathbf{r}_{ij} = \mathbf{r}_i - \mathbf{r}_j$, $r = \|\mathbf{r}_{ij}\|$, $\hat{\mathbf{e}}_{ij} = \mathbf{r}_{ij}/r$, and $\mathbf{v}_{ij} = \mathbf{v}_i - \mathbf{v}_j$:
- For $r \ge r_c$ (or $r = 0$), return `(zeros(3), zeros(3))`.
- For $0 < r < r_c$, use $w_R(r) = 1 - r/r_c$, Espanol-Warren $w_D(r) = [w_R(r)]^2$, and $\sigma = \sqrt{2\gamma k_B T}$:
$$\mathbf{F}_i = -\gamma w_D(r)(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_{ij}\cdot\mathbf{v}_{ij})\hat{\mathbf{e}}_{ij} + \sigma w_R(r)\,\xi_{\text{sym}}\,\Delta t^{-1/2}\,\hat{\mathbf{e}}_{ij}, \qquad \mathbf{F}_j = -\mathbf{F}_i$$
returning `(F_i, F_j)`.

import numpy as np

def dpd_pairwise_thermostat_forces(r_i, r_j, v_i, v_j, r_c, gamma_dpd, kT, dt, xi_sym):

    raise NotImplementedError('Implement dpd_pairwise_thermostat_forces')
